一名男子以其拥有的一栋办公楼作抵押，获得了一笔银行贷款。几年后，该男子将办公楼转让给一名女子，该女子在接受所有权时受该抵押权的约束。该转让给女子的契据未被登记。该女子立即占有了该建筑，并连续数年支付抵押贷款。

随后，该女子停止支付抵押贷款，银行最终启动了止赎程序，并将男子和女子都列为当事人。在止赎拍卖中，第三方以低于抵押贷款未偿余额的价格购买了该建筑。银行随后试图向该女子追讨差额。

银行是否有权向该女子追讨差额？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为该女子没有登记从该男子处获得的契据。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为该女子对该贷款不承担个人责任。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为该女子从该男子处购买该建筑时立即占有了它。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为该女子是止赎程序的一方当事人。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Transfer

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：买受人只是受抵押权约束（take subject to the mortgage），并没有承继抵押债务（assume the mortgage）时，银行能不能向她追差额。

三秒认题路径：

先看转让 → 再看承担 → 再看追差额 → 只受抵押 → 不能追她

核心法律规则

房屋卖出去以后，抵押（mortgage）通常还跟着房子走；但原借款人还是对债务负责。关键只看受让人有没有承继抵押（assume the mortgage）：如果只是受抵押权约束（take subject to the mortgage），她不答应替贷款人还钱，所以不承担个人责任。

一旦拍卖价不够还清贷款，银行当然可以追差额（deficiency），但只能追真正对债务个人负责的人。对只是受抵押权约束的买受人，终局后也还是这个结论。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.2 说明：受让人若只是受抵押权约束，不会因为接手房产就自动承担个人清偿责任。

思维导图

借款人 原始债务人 / mortgagor
→
房屋转给买受人 先看是否只是 subject to
→
只受抵押权约束 不承诺还款
→
违约后止赎 foreclosure sale 不足额
→
差额不能向她追 no personal liability = no deficiency
卡死点：她没有承继贷款，所以银行不能把“欠钱的人”变成她。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她搬进去住了，还一直交月供，看起来就是接手这笔房贷。
但考试真正问的是：她有没有明确承继抵押（assume the mortgage），而不是有没有实际控制房子。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。 同理，这题看的是有没有个人债务责任，不是她有没有占用、付款或参加诉讼。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干已经写明她只是took title subject to the mortgage，这表示她没有个人还款义务，所以银行不能向她追差额（deficiency）。

❌ 事实误判 | 记录效力偷换

✕ A: 误把not recorded当成债务责任问题，记录与否不决定能否追差额。

❌ 概念混淆 | 占有即承债

✕ C: 误以为immediate possession就等于承继贷款，住进去不等于自己背债。

❌ 法律适用 | 当事人身份误判

✕ D: 只是被列为诉讼当事人，不会自动变成承担个人债务的人。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓转让方式，再问有没有承继债务；只要是 subject to，就直接排除追买受人差额。

考场速记

记住一句：subject to 只管房子，不管个人债；assume 才会把买受人拉进还款责任。看到“止赎后追差额”，先问买受人到底有没有承债。

reason.en: Creates the secured debt and foreclosure framework.
reason.zh: 构成担保债务与止赎程序的基础。

reason.en: Determines whether the grantee assumes personal liability for the debt.
reason.zh: 决定受让人是否承担贷款个人责任。

reason.en: A distractor fact; recording does not affect deficiency liability here.
reason.zh: 干扰性事实；登记与否不影响不足额追偿责任。

reason.en: Sets the context for sale proceeds and any deficiency claim.
reason.zh: 确立拍卖处置及不足额追偿的诉讼背景。

reason.en: The remedy the bank seeks after an insufficient foreclosure sale.
reason.zh: 止赎价款不足后银行寻求的追偿救济。

reason.en: Payment history does not convert subject-to status into personal liability.
reason.zh: 付款记录不会将承受抵押转为个人偿债义务。

reason.en: Transfers title while the mortgage remains attached to the property.
reason.zh: 转移所有权但抵押仍附着于该不动产。

reason.en: Recording affects notice, not a subject-to grantee's personal deficiency liability.
reason.zh: 登记仅影响公示效力，不决定承受抵押者的不足额个人责任。

B.text: not personally liable on the loan

reason.en: States the correct rule: a subject-to grantee owes no personal debt on the mortgage.
reason.zh: 正确规则：承受抵押的受让人不承担抵押贷款个人债务。

reason.en: Possession and payment do not create assumption of the mortgage debt.
reason.zh: 占有与付款并不构成承担抵押贷款债务。

reason.en: Being named in foreclosure does not make a grantee personally liable for a deficiency.
reason.zh: 被列为止赎当事人并不产生不足额个人偿债义务。

highlights.text: took title subject to the mortgage

reason.en: This language means the woman did not assume personal liability for the debt.
reason.zh: 该表述表明女方未承担贷款的个人偿债义务。

highlights.text: The bank then sought to collect the deficiency from the woman.

reason.en: Frames whether the lender may recover the shortfall personally from the grantee.
reason.zh: 界定银行能否向受让人个人追偿价款不足部分。

highlights.text: The deed to the woman was not recorded.

reason.en: Tempts test-takers to tie liability to recording, which is irrelevant here.
reason.zh: 易诱使考生将责任与登记挂钩，但此处无关。

highlights.text: the man and the woman were both named parties

reason.en: Supports the distractor that foreclosure participation creates deficiency liability.
reason.zh: 支撑“参与止赎即负不足额责任”的错误选项。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A franchisee owned a hotel, subject to a mortgage securing a debt that the franchisee owed to a bank. The franchisee later acquired a nearby parking garage, financing a part of the purchase price by a loan from a credit union, secured by a mortgage on the parking garage. Two years thereafter, the franchisee defaulted on the loan owed to the bank, which caused the full amount of that loan to become immediately due and payable. The bank decided not to foreclose the mortgage on the franchisee's hotel at that time but instead brought an action, appropriate under the laws of the jurisdiction and authorized by the mortgage loan documents, for the full amount of the defaulted loan. The bank obtained and properly filed a judgment for that amount.
A statute of the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered." There is no other applicable statute, except the statute providing for judicial foreclosure of mortgages, which places no restriction on deficiency judgments.
The bank later brought an appropriate action for judicial foreclosure of its first mortgage on the hotel and of its judgment lien on the parking garage. The credit union was joined as a party defendant, and appropriately counterclaimed for foreclosure of its mortgage on the parking garage, which was also in default. All procedures were properly followed, and the confirmed foreclosure sales resulted as follows:
The bank purchased the hotel for $100,000 less than its mortgage balance.
The bank purchased the parking garage for an amount that is $200,000 in excess of the credit union's mortgage balance.
How should the $200,000 surplus arising from the bid paid by the bank for the parking garage be paid?

choices.A: $100,000 to the bank and $100,000 to the credit union.
choices.B: $100,000 to the bank and $100,000 to the franchisee.
choices.C: $100,000 to the credit union and $100,000 to the franchisee.
choices.D: $200,000 to the franchisee.

questions.explanation:
Distribution of foreclosure sale proceeds.

Proceeds from a foreclosure sale are typically distributed in the following order of priority:

  • Expenses from the sale (eg, attorneys' fees, court costs)
  • Mortgage being foreclosed
  • Junior liens, in order of lien priority留置权顺位：多个担保权益依成立或登记时间先后排列的受偿顺序（先成立者优先）。
  • Debtor, if any surplus remains

Here, the credit union had the senior lien on the parking garage since its mortgage was placed on the property first. The bank later acquired a judgment lien on all the franchisee's property—including a junior lien on the garage—when the franchisee defaulted on the bank's loan. And since the foreclosure sale of the garage satisfied the credit union's entire mortgage and created a $200,000 surplus, the bank (as the junior lienholder) should receive $100,000 to cover the balance still owed under its mortgage on the hotel. The remaining surplus ($100,000) should then be distributed to the franchisee (Choices A, C & D).

📌 Educational Objective

Proceeds from a foreclosure sale are typically distributed in the following order: expenses, foreclosed mortgage, junior liens, then the debtor.

📚 References
  • 55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 705 (2019) (distribution of foreclosure sale proceeds).
questions.zh-question:
一名特许经营人拥有一家酒店，该酒店设有抵押权，用以担保该特许经营人欠银行的一笔债务。该特许经营人后来收购了附近的一个停车库，部分购买价款通过信用合作社的贷款融资，并以该停车库的抵押权作为担保。两年后，该特许经营人拖欠了应付给银行的贷款，导致该笔贷款全额立即到期应付。当时，银行决定不对此特许经营人酒店的抵押权进行止赎，而是根据该司法管辖区的法律和抵押贷款文件的授权，就拖欠贷款的全额提起了诉讼。银行获得了该金额的判决，并进行了妥善登记。

该司法管辖区的一项法规规定：“任何妥善登记的判决，自登记之日起十年内，均构成对被判决人当时拥有或随后获得的任何不动产的留置权。” 除规定司法止赎抵押权的法规外，没有其他适用的法规，而该法规对差额判决不加限制。

之后，银行提起了适当的诉讼，要求对酒店的第一顺位抵押权以及对停车库的判决留置权进行司法止赎。信用合作社作为共同被告加入诉讼，并就其对停车库的抵押权（该抵押权也已违约）适当地提出了止赎的反诉。所有程序均得到妥善遵守，经确认的止赎拍卖结果如下：

银行以低于其抵押贷款余额100,000美元的价格购买了该酒店。

银行购买该停车库的价格，比信用合作社的抵押贷款余额高出200,000美元。

银行竞拍停车库所支付的款项产生的200,000美元盈余应如何支付？

zh-choices.A: 100,000美元支付给银行，100,000美元支付给信用合作社。
zh-choices.B: 100,000美元支付给银行，100,000美元支付给特许经营人。
zh-choices.C: 100,000美元支付给信用合作社，100,000美元支付给特许经营人。
zh-choices.D: 200,000美元支付给特许经营人。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Foreclosure

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：抵押止赎拍卖（foreclosure sale）后，多余价款要先还被止赎的这笔抵押，再按顺位清偿次级留置权（junior liens），最后才轮到债务人。

三秒认题路径：

拍卖溢价 → 先还被止赎抵押 → 再看次级留置权 → 还完才给债务人 → 选能排到顺位的那方

核心法律规则

止赎拍卖价款的分配顺序是：先付拍卖费用（expenses of sale），再付被止赎抵押（mortgage being foreclosed），然后按顺位支付次级留置权（junior liens），剩余部分才给债务人（debtor）。

这里的关键不是“谁对这处房产最有情绪”，而是谁在这块不动产上排位更靠前。拍卖先把前一层债清干净，后面的权利人才有资格拿钱。

核心判例： 本题不靠特殊判例，直接套用止赎价款的法定顺位：费用、被止赎抵押、次级留置权、债务人。

思维导图

拍卖价款 先看这笔钱够不够层层往下分
→
止赎费用 题干未争点，先扣除
→
被止赎抵押 本题是银行对酒店的第一抵押
→
次级留置权 银行的判决留置权排在后面
→
债务人 只有还有剩余，才轮到 franchisee
停车楼拍卖多出 $200,000，先问：这笔 surplus 是给谁？
先清：信用合作社的停车楼第一抵押已被拍卖款清完。
再看：银行还有 $100,000 的欠款，作为次级留置权人先拿这部分。
最后：剩下的 $100,000 才给债务人 franchisee。
卡死点：银行不能把这 200,000 全吃掉；它只拿自己在停车楼上的次级留置权范围内那 100,000。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：银行既然对酒店还有欠款，就应该把停车楼溢价也都拿走。

但考试真正问的是：这笔钱按留置权顺位（lien priority）怎么分，不是看谁总体还欠多少钱。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

停车楼的 $200,000 surplus 先补银行在该房产上的次级留置权 $100,000，剩下的 $100,000 才回到 franchisee。

❌ 概念混淆 | 以总债代顺位

这题建议用什么方法？

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman borrowed money from a bank in order to build a new barn on her 20-acre farm. The loan was secured by a 10-year mortgage on the farm. The mortgage contained an acceleration clause. After three years, the woman defaulted on the loan. The bank sent a certified letter to the woman notifying her of its intention to accelerate the loan unless she cured the default within 75 days.
The woman was unable to make the required payment by the 75-day deadline to cure the default. As a result, the bank accelerated the loan and initiated foreclosure proceedings against the woman. The day after being served with a summons and complaint, the woman informed the bank that she was able to make the two outstanding mortgage payments, including late fees and interest. The woman then filed a motion to dismiss the foreclosure proceedings.
Should the motion to dismiss be granted?

choices.A: No, because the bank initiated the foreclosure, which terminated the woman's right to redemption.
choices.B: No, because the woman does not have enough money to force the bank to accept her payment.
choices.C: Yes, because the bank is clogging the equity of redemption by failing to accept her payment.
choices.D: Yes, because the woman has properly exercised the statutory right of redemption.

questions.explanation:
Common mortgage provisions
Acceleration clause Allows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor defaults
Due-on-sale clause Allows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor sells mortgaged property without permission
Due-on-encumbrance clause Allows creditor to accelerate mortgage obligation if debtor obtains second mortgage or otherwise encumbers property
Defeasance clause Requires creditor to give debtor legal title to property & release mortgage lien once all payments are made

Mortgage documents often contain an acceleration clause, which allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt plus any accrued interest if the debtor (mortgagor) defaults on the mortgage loan. If the debtor is unable to pay, then the lender can move forward with foreclosure proceedings to recover any remaining debt.

However, the doctrine of equitable redemption gives the debtor an opportunity to retain the property and avoid foreclosure by paying the amount of the loan obligation currently owed at any time prior to the foreclosure sale. If the mortgage documents contain an acceleration clause, then the debtor must pay the full amount of the unpaid loan plus interest to redeem the property.

Here, the woman was unable to cure her default by the bank's 75-day deadline, so the bank initiated foreclosure proceedings. Although the woman was able to make the two outstanding mortgage payments plus late fees and interest, the acceleration clause required that she pay the full amount of the unpaid loan plus interest to redeem the property. Since the woman does not have enough money to do so, her motion to dismiss the foreclosure proceedings should be denied.

(Choice A) The foreclosure sale—not the initiation of the foreclosure proceedings—terminated the equitable right of redemption.

(Choice C) The principle of clogging the equity of redemption refers to a lender's attempt to deny the debtor the right to redemption after the mortgage is executed—eg, by including a waiver clause in the mortgage. Since no waiver occurred here, this principle does not apply.

(Choice D) Many states recognize a statutory right of redemption that allows a debtor to reclaim the property after a foreclosure sale—not before the sale, as the woman seeks to do here.

📌 Educational Objective

An acceleration clause allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt plus any accrued interest if the debtor defaults on the mortgage loan. If the debtor is unable to pay, then the lender can move forward with foreclosure proceedings.
questions.zh-question:
一名女性为在她20英亩的农场上建造一个新谷仓而向银行贷款。该贷款由该农场的一项为期10年的抵押作担保。该抵押合同包含一项加速清偿条款。三年后，该女性贷款违约。银行向该女性寄送了一封挂号信，通知她银行打算加速清偿贷款，除非她在75天内纠正其违约行为。

该女性未能在75天的最后期限内支付所需款项以纠正违约。因此，银行加速清偿了贷款，并对该女性提起了止赎程序。在收到传票和起诉状的第二天，该女性通知银行她能够支付两笔逾期未付的抵押贷款，包括滞纳金和利息。该女性随后提出动议，请求驳回止赎程序。

该驳回动议是否应被批准？

zh-choices.A: 不应批准，因为银行提起止赎程序终止了该女性的赎回权。
zh-choices.B: 不应批准，因为该女性没有足够的资金来迫使银行接受她的付款。
zh-choices.C: 应批准，因为银行拒绝接受她的付款，从而妨碍了衡平法上的赎回权。
zh-choices.D: 应批准，因为该女性已正当行使其法定赎回权。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Foreclosure

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：抵押人违约后，加速条款（acceleration clause）已经触发时，借款人能否只补上逾期分期款就阻止止赎；答案是否定的，因为她必须付清被加速后的全部到期债务。

三秒认题路径：

违约 → 加速条款 → 赎回截止前 → 必须付清全额 → 不能驳回止赎

核心法律规则

加速条款（acceleration clause）的考场意思：一旦借款人违约，银行可以把剩余全部贷款一次性提前到期，外加应计利息，不再只是收几期月供。

衡平法赎回权（equitable redemption）的考场意思：在foreclosure sale之前，借款人还能赎回房产，但前提是把当前真正到期的债务一次付清；如果有加速条款，就得付清全部未偿本金和利息。

所以，这题里女方只拿得出两期月供、滞纳金和利息，不够覆盖被加速后的总额，法院不会因为她“现在想补救”就命令银行撤掉止赎。

核心判例： 没有特定判例争点，本题按普通抵押法规则判断：加速后，赎回必须付清全部未偿债务。

思维导图

先问：现在是不是已经到了“还可以赎回”的阶段？
是，且还没到 foreclosure sale：
再看：抵押合同里有没有 加速条款（acceleration clause）？
有：
借款人要想保住房子，必须付清 全部未偿贷款 + 利息。
她只想补两期月供 → 这不够 → 不能让银行撤回止赎。
别被带偏：
不是看她“愿不愿意补钱”，而是看她“能不能一次付到加速后的总额”。
结论：motion to dismiss 应该被拒绝。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她已经补上了欠缴月供，还加了滞纳金和利息，银行应该收钱、放她一马。

但考试真正问的是：加速条款（acceleration clause）生效后，赎回要不要按“全部剩余债务”来算，而不是按“拖欠的那几期”来算。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「情绪上看起来够不够公平」。 这里不是“她愿意补交多少”，而是“她有没有能力一次付清被加速后的总额”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的 加速条款 已把债务变成“全额到期”，而她只够补两期月供，不能强迫银行接受部分付款并撤销止赎。

❌ 事实误判 | 终局时点偷换

✕ A: 把foreclosure initiated当成赎回结束点了。

❌ 概念混淆 | clogging误套

✕ C: 这是把clogging当成“拒收现钱”的借口。

❌ 法律适用 | 事前事后错位

✕ D: statutory redemption是拍卖后才可能谈的权利。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看是否加速，再看赎回时点，最后只问她能不能一次付清全部到期债务。

考场速记

记住一句：违约 + 加速后，衡平法赎回权（equitable redemption）要救房子，通常得付清全部未偿本金和利息；只补拖欠月供，不够。

口诀：In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely 不是本题重点；本题只记“加速后，赎回看全额”。

reason.en: After default, it requires payment of the entire unpaid balance to redeem.
reason.zh: 违约后赎回房产须偿付全部未偿贷款余额。

reason.en: Her failure to cure by this deadline triggered acceleration and foreclosure.
reason.zh: 未在此期限内补救违约触发了贷款加速与止赎。

reason.en: Foreclosure began after acceleration, but redemption may still exist before sale.
reason.zh: 加速后银行启动止赎，但在拍卖前赎回权仍可能存在。

reason.en: Her offered payment covers arrearages, not the full accelerated balance.
reason.zh: 其拟付款仅涵盖拖欠分期，不足以偿付加速后的全部债务。

reason.en: Default activated the acceleration clause and foreclosure remedy.
reason.zh: 违约激活加速条款并使银行可寻求止赎救济。

keywords.text: motion to dismiss the foreclosure proceedings

reason.en: The motion succeeds only if she validly redeems before sale.
reason.zh: 只有她在拍卖前有效赎回，该驳回动议才会成功。

A.text: terminated the woman's right to redemption

reason.en: Misstates that foreclosure initiation, not the sale, ends equitable redemption.
reason.zh: 误称止赎启动而非拍卖才终止衡平赎回权。

reason.en: Starting foreclosure does not itself extinguish the right to redeem before sale.
reason.zh: 启动止赎本身并不消灭拍卖前的赎回权。

reason.en: She cannot pay the full accelerated loan balance required to redeem.
reason.zh: 她无力支付加速后赎回所需的全部贷款余额。

B.text: force the bank to accept her payment

reason.en: After acceleration, the bank need not accept less than the full amount due.
reason.zh: 加速后银行无须接受低于全部到期金额的付款。

reason.en: Applies a mortgage-formation doctrine, not refusal of post-default partial payment.
reason.zh: 适用的是设立抵押时的原则，而非拒绝违约后的部分付款。

reason.en: The bank may refuse partial payment once full acceleration amount is due.
reason.zh: 全部加速金额到期后，银行可拒绝部分付款。

reason.en: Confuses post-foreclosure-sale redemption with pre-sale equitable redemption.
reason.zh: 将拍卖后的法定赎回与拍卖前的衡平赎回相混淆。

reason.en: She seeks pre-sale dismissal, not post-sale statutory redemption.
reason.zh: 她寻求的是拍卖前驳回止赎，而非拍卖后法定赎回。

highlights.text: The mortgage contained an acceleration clause.

reason.en: Controls whether full unpaid balance, not just arrearages, must be paid to redeem.
reason.zh: 决定赎回须付全部未偿余额而非仅拖欠分期。

highlights.text: The woman was unable to make the required payment by the 75-day deadline to cure the default.

reason.en: Her uncured default justified loan acceleration and foreclosure.
reason.zh: 未补救的违约使银行得以加速贷款并启动止赎。

highlights.text: the bank accelerated the loan and initiated foreclosure proceedings against the woman

reason.en: After acceleration, redemption requires paying the entire unpaid debt before sale.
reason.zh: 加速后，须在拍卖前偿付全部未偿债务方可赎回。

highlights.text: she was able to make the two outstanding mortgage payments, including late fees and interest

reason.en: This amount is insufficient under an accelerated mortgage to stop foreclosure.
reason.zh: 在加速条款下，该金额不足以阻止止赎。

highlights.text: Should the motion to dismiss be granted?

reason.en: The answer turns on whether she can validly redeem before the foreclosure sale.
reason.zh: 答案取决于她能否在止赎拍卖前有效赎回。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A newly married couple, anxious to start a life together, decided to build a new home. They financed the home by executing a 15-year promissory note and purchase-money mortgage to the bank. The mortgage, which contained a power-of-sale clause, was promptly recorded.
Seven years later, the couple legally separated. Neither could afford the mortgage payments on their individual salary, so they abandoned the home and stopped making mortgage payments. After the couple missed two payments, the bank decided to initiate a foreclosure proceeding.
The jurisdiction follows the title theory of mortgages and allows for nonjudicial foreclosures.
Which of the following actions poses the most financial risk to the bank?

choices.A: Accepting a deed in lieu of foreclosure.
choices.B: Entering the property to make repairs prior to foreclosure.
choices.C: Foreclosing on the mortgage through a privately conducted public sale.
choices.D: Leasing the home to a tenant.

questions.explanation:
This jurisdiction follows the title theory of mortgages, so a lender is considered the owner of the mortgaged property until the mortgage debt is fully satisfied. This gives the lender the right to take possession of the property at any time (unless the mortgage states otherwise). If the lender takes possession, then it assumes the duty to take reasonable care of the property until foreclosure proceedings end.

The duty of reasonable care includes the duty not to commit waste that would impair the value of the property. As a result, the lender is liable to the borrower if the value of the property is reduced because of the lender's actions during foreclosure proceedings.

Here, if the bank chooses to lease the home, it runs the risk that the tenant will damage the property. Damage to the property reduces any equity that the borrower (here, the couple) may have in the home. Such damage would amount to waste, for which the bank would have to account to the couple during the foreclosure proceedings. Therefore, leasing the home to a tenant poses the most financial risk to the bank.

(Choice A) A borrower may deed all interest in the property to the lender in lieu of foreclosure. This poses minimal financial risk to the lender because it allows the lender to take immediate possession of the property without any further legal formalities and to generally reserve the right to pursue a deficiency against the debtor.

(Choice B) The bank may enter the property to make repairs prior to foreclosure because this would likely increase the value of the property — not impair it.

(Choice C) In jurisdictions that permit nonjudicial foreclosure, a lender may foreclose on a mortgage through a privately conducted public sale when the mortgage contains a power-of-sale clause (as seen here). This allows the bank to foreclose without court intervention.

📌 Educational Objective

A lender has the right to take possession of mortgaged property but is liable to the borrower for any waste that the lender commits during foreclosure proceedings.
questions.zh-question:
一对新婚夫妇，渴望开始共同生活，决定建造一栋新房子。他们通过向银行签署一份为期15年的本票和购房抵押贷款来为房屋融资。该抵押合同包含一项出售权条款，并已及时登记。

七年后，这对夫妇合法分居。由于各自的薪水都无法负担抵押贷款的还款，他们放弃了该房屋并停止支付抵押贷款。在夫妇错过两期还款后，银行决定启动止赎程序。

该司法管辖区遵循抵押的产权理论（title theory of mortgages），并允许非司法止赎。

以下哪项行为给银行带来最大的财务风险？

zh-choices.A: 接受一份替代止赎的契据。
zh-choices.B: 在止赎前进入房产进行维修。
zh-choices.C: 通过私下举行的公开拍卖来对抵押进行止赎。
zh-choices.D: 将房屋出租给租户。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Pre-Foreclosure Rights And Duties

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：标题理论（title theory）下，银行一旦掌握占有权，若在止赎前把房子出租给租客并造成损害，就可能因浪费（waste）而对借款人承担责任，所以这才是最有财务风险的动作。

三秒认题路径：

title theory → 银行可占有 → 出租给租客 → 可能毁损 → 风险最大

核心法律规则

在标题理论（title theory）州，抵押权人/放款银行在贷款清偿前被视为房产的名义所有人，所以通常可以进入并占有房屋。占有（possession）以后，银行要对房产尽合理照管，考场意思：不能把房子搞坏、不能让价值被自己行动拉低。

这里的关键词是浪费（waste），也就是银行的行为让房屋价值下降、借款人股本变少。止赎（foreclosure）还没结束前，如果银行把房子租出去，租客毁损的风险会直接落到银行头上。

核心判例： 本题考的是常规 MBE 规则，不需要额外判例；记住标题理论下的占有权与浪费责任即可锁定结论。

思维导图

先看：银行现在在止赎前有没有占有权？
YES
标题理论下，银行可占有房屋，但同时背上照管义务。
再问
银行做的是不是会让房屋价值下降的事？
如果会让价值下跌，就是waste，要向借款人负责。
出租给租客 → 租客可能毁损 → 借款人股本缩水 → 风险最大。
结论：选 D
NO / 不是这个动作
只是修理、直接非司法止赎、或接受以房抵债，通常都不是本题最危险点。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：银行既然能进屋，就可以随便处理房子，甚至出租也只是“管理资产”。

但考试真正问的是：这个动作会不会把房屋价值弄坏，从而让银行在止赎期间对借款人承担浪费（waste）责任。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。这里不是比谁先拿到控制权，而是比谁先把价值风险背上身。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干 租给 tenant 会让租客毁损房屋，直接压低借款人剩余权益；在 title theory 下，这种价值损失可能算银行的 waste，所以最有财务风险。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 以为 deed in lieu 会更危险，其实这是银行更省事的拿房方式。

❌ 事实误判 | 修缮风险夸大

✕ B: 把 make repairs 当成毁损，其实修房通常是在保值，不是制造风险。

❌ 法律适用 | 中间上诉理由误判

✕ C: 看到 public sale 就以为最冒险，但这只是非司法止赎的正常路径。

这题建议用什么方法？

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman borrowed $500,000 from a bank. She signed a note to the bank and secured repayment of the loan with a mortgage on a commercial tract that she owned. The note and mortgage did not contain a due-on-sale clause. Several months later, the woman conveyed the commercial tract to her business partner. The conveyance provided that "the grantee assumes and agrees to pay the existing mortgage to the bank." The business partner then conveyed the tract to a buyer "subject to the existing mortgage to the bank." Each grantee received a copy of the note and the mortgage.
After the buyer made several timely payments, no further payments were made by any party. The bank initiated a foreclosure action, naming the woman, the business partner, and the buyer as defendants. The foreclosure sale resulted in a deficiency.
There are no applicable statutes.
Against whom is the bank entitled to collect a deficiency judgment?

choices.A: The business partner and the buyer.
choices.B: The woman.
choices.C: The woman and the business partner.
choices.D: The woman, the business partner, and the buyer.

questions.explanation:
Woman mortgages to bank
Partner assumes mortgage
Buyer takes subject to mortgage
Woman
Partner
Buyer
{ Liable to bank
→ Not liable
= agrees to pay debt

A debtor is free to sell mortgaged property unless the mortgage agreement states otherwise. After the sale, the mortgage remains attached to the property and the debtor remains personally liable for the debt secured by the mortgage. But the buyer's obligations with respect to the mortgage depend on whether he/she:

  • took the property subject to the mortgage – in which case the buyer does not agree to pay, and is not personally liable for, the debt (even if the buyer makes payments on the loan) or
  • assumed the mortgage – in which case the buyer expressly agrees to pay and becomes primarily liable for the debt, while the debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.

Therefore, if a creditor forecloses on mortgaged property and the sale results in a deficiency—ie, the proceeds are insufficient to satisfy the debt—the creditor can obtain a deficiency judgment against the original debtor and/or any party who has assumed the mortgage.

Here, the woman mortgaged the commercial tract to a bank and then conveyed the tract to her business partner, who assumed the mortgage. The business partner then conveyed the tract to the buyer, who took it subject to the mortgage. Although the buyer made payments on the loan, this did not constitute an assumption of liability for the debt. As a result, the bank is entitled to collect a deficiency judgment only against the woman and the business partner (Choices A, B & D).

📌 Educational Objective

When a foreclosure sale results in a deficiency, the creditor can obtain a deficiency judgment against (1) the original debtor and/or (2) any party who has assumed the mortgage.

📚 References
  • 55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 967 (2019) (deficiency judgments).
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.1 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (assuming a mortgage debt).
questions.zh-question:
一名女子向银行借款50万美元。她向银行签署了一张本票，并用她拥有的一块商业地块的抵押权来担保贷款的偿还。该本票和抵押合同不包含“售出即付”条款。几个月后，该女子将该商业地块转让给了她的商业伙伴，转让“以银行的抵押权为负担，受让人承担并同意偿还”。该商业伙伴随后将地块转让给一位买家，“以银行的现有抵押权为负担”。每位受让人都收到了一份本票和抵押合同的副本。

在买家按时支付了几笔款项后，没有任何一方再进行支付。银行提起了止赎诉讼，将该女子、其商业伙伴和买家列为被告。止赎拍卖导致了差额。

本案没有适用的成文法。

银行有权向谁追讨差额判决？

zh-choices.A: 商业伙伴和买家。
zh-choices.B: 该女子。
zh-choices.C: 该女子和商业伙伴。
zh-choices.D: 该女子、商业伙伴和买家。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Mortgage transfers

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：转让抵押房产后，assumes the mortgage 的人会对银行承担缺口责任，而只是 subject to the mortgage 的买家通常不承担个人责任。

三秒认题路径：

转让房产 → 看承诺措辞 → 区分 assume / subject → 查缺口 → 找可追偿人

核心法律规则

抵押房产可以转让，但mortgage（抵押权） 仍跟着房子走，原借款人对债务通常仍要负责，考场意思：银行先看谁原本签了钱和抵押。

若受让人明确 assume the mortgage（承担抵押债务），他就变成主要债务人；若只是 take subject to the mortgage（受制于抵押），他只是“房子带着抵押买走”，考场意思：不等于他亲口答应替银行还钱。

一旦拍卖后出现 deficiency（剩余债务缺口），银行可向原债务人和任何已经承担抵押债务的人追缺口，但不能只因后来一直付过几期就把“subject”买家当成个人债务人。

核心判例： 本题考的是传统抵押转让规则：assumption 才带来对债务的个人责任，subject to 只让房子继续担保，不自动让买家背个人欠款。

思维导图

女方 原借款人 / 原抵押人
→
业务伙伴 明确承担（assumes）
→
买家 仅受制于抵押（subject to）
银行追缺口先看：谁亲口答应还钱？
女方：原来签了本票和抵押，拍卖后仍可被追缺口。
业务伙伴：写明 assumes the mortgage，所以对银行个人负责。
买家：只有 subject to the existing mortgage，没有承诺还债。
卡死点：subject to 不等于承担债务，不能把买家算进缺口判决。
结论：只能向女方和业务伙伴追缺口，答案锁定 C。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：买家也一直在付款，像是默认接手了贷款。

但考试真正问的是：他有没有明确 assume 债务；只要题干写的是 subject to，就不要把付款动作当成个人承诺。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干一写 assumes the mortgage，业务伙伴就对债务个人负责；买家只有 subject to the existing mortgage，不算承担缺口。

❌ 概念混淆 | 付款当承诺

✕ A: 把后续付款误当成 assume，其实买家没接个人债务。

❌ 事实误判 | 漏掉受让人

✕ B: 只盯原借款人，漏看业务伙伴已明确承担抵押。

❌ 法律适用 | 责任范围外推

✕ D: 把 subject to 也算进缺口责任，规则不认这个跳法。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓转让措辞，再分清 assume 和 subject to，最后回到缺口判决追偿对象。

考场速记

记忆口诀：assume = 人背债，subject to = 房背债；拍卖有缺口时，只追原债务人和已承担债务的人。

reason.en: Its absence confirms the conveyances did not accelerate the debt.
reason.zh: 无此条款说明转让并未触发贷款加速。

keywords.text: assumes and agrees to pay the existing mortgage

reason.en: Creates personal liability for the business partner on the debt.
reason.zh: 使商业伙伴对债务承担个人清偿责任。

reason.en: Buyer takes the property without assuming personal liability for the debt.
reason.zh: 买方取得财产但不承担债务的个人责任。

reason.en: Sets the stage for seeking a deficiency after the sale.
reason.zh: 为拍卖后追讨不足额判决提供程序基础。

reason.en: The remedy at issue limits who may be sued personally.
reason.zh: 本案争议救济决定可向谁追索个人责任。

keywords.text: the buyer made several timely payments

reason.en: Payment alone does not convert a subject-to buyer into an assumer.
reason.zh: 仅付款不足以使在抵押下受让的买方承担债务。

label.zh: 在抵押下受让买方责任

reason.en: Wrongly treats the subject-to buyer as personally liable.
reason.zh: 错误地将仅在抵押下受让的买方视为个人债务人。

reason.en: Omits the partner who assumed the mortgage.
reason.zh: 遗漏了已承担抵押的商业伙伴。

reason.en: Identifies the party who expressly assumed personal liability.
reason.zh: 指明明确承担个人清偿责任的当事人。

label.zh: 纳入在抵押下受让买方

reason.en: Overbroadly includes a non-assuming buyer in deficiency liability.
reason.zh: 错误地将未承担义务的买方纳入不足额追索范围。

highlights.text: assumes and agrees to pay the existing mortgage

reason.en: This language makes the business partner personally liable for the debt.
reason.zh: 此表述使商业伙伴对债务承担个人清偿责任。

highlights.text: subject to the existing mortgage

reason.en: A subject-to grantee is not personally liable even if payments are made.
reason.zh: 在抵押下取得者不承担个人责任，即使曾付款亦然。

highlights.text: The foreclosure sale resulted in a deficiency.

reason.en: Triggers the question of who may be sued for the unpaid balance.
reason.zh: 引出可向谁追讨未偿余额的法律问题。

highlights.text: the buyer made several timely payments

reason.en: Distracts examinees into treating payment as assumption of liability.
reason.zh: 易误导考生将付款误认为承担债务义务。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
An aspiring dancer purchased an apartment near the theater district from a local real estate broker. To complete the sale, the dancer signed a document entitled "Contract for Deed." The document provided that the dancer was to pay the broker in monthly installments over a five-year period for the apartment, but it was silent as to remedies in the event of any default.
Four years later, after never missing a payment, the dancer suffered a severe injury and was out of work for many months. When she missed a monthly payment, the broker notified her that he intended to retake possession of the apartment. The dancer refused to surrender possession unless the broker refunded some of the money that she paid him over the years.
Which of the following outcomes is the court LEAST likely to impose?

choices.A: Require the broker to initiate judicial foreclosure proceedings on the property.
choices.B: Require the broker to refund the dancer's payments to the extent that they exceed the broker's actual damages upon forfeiture.
choices.C: Require the dancer to indemnify the broker for the delinquent payments in order to retain possession.
choices.D: Require the dancer to pay the remaining contract balance to retain possession and obtain ownership.

questions.explanation:
Mortgage alternatives
Absolute deed Debtor gives deed to creditor with intent to secure loan (ie, equitable mortgage)
Deed of trust Debtor gives deed of trust to third-party trustee as collateral for debt, & creditor can instruct trustee to foreclose upon default
Installment land contract Debtor agrees to buy land through installment payments & gets immediate possession, but seller keeps legal title until paid in full
Sale-leaseback Seller leases property from buyer immediately after sale, & seller's rental payments function as repayments on loan
Equitable vendor's lien Seller finances buyer's purchase with equitable vendor's lien when seller transfers title to buyer but purchase price not fully paid

A contract for deed (ie, installment land contract) is a type of mortgage alternative. Under this contract, the buyer may take immediate possession of the property, but the seller retains title until the buyer makes the final payment under an installment payment plan. Traditionally, a contract for deed allowed the seller to keep all installment payments and retake possession if the buyer failed to make a single payment—even if all but one payment was made. However, states now seek to assist a buyer in default by:

  • treating an installment land contract as a mortgage and requiring the seller to foreclose on the property to gain clear title (Choice A)
  • offering the buyer the equitable right of redemption by paying the remaining contract balance to retain possession and obtain ownership (Choice D) or
  • allowing the seller to retain ownership of the property but requiring some form of restitution to the buyer—eg, refunding the contract payments to the extent that they exceed the damages caused to the seller by the buyer's default (Choice B).

However, a buyer cannot regain possession by merely indemnifying (ie, reimbursing) the seller for the missed payments. Therefore, the court is least likely to impose this outcome.

📌 Educational Objective

A contract for deed allows a buyer to take immediate possession of the property while the seller retains title until the final installment payment is made. The seller could traditionally keep all installment payments and retake possession upon default. But states now assist buyers in default by requiring a foreclosure, offering the equitable right of redemption, or granting the buyer restitution.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 3.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (contract for deed).
questions.zh-question:
一位有抱负的舞蹈演员从当地一名房地产经纪人处购买了一套靠近剧院区的公寓。为完成此次销售，该舞蹈演员签署了一份名为“契约合同”(Contract for Deed)的文件。该文件规定，舞蹈演员将在五年内以月度分期付款的方式向经纪人支付公寓款项，但对任何违约情况下的救济措施只字未提。

四年后，在从未错过任何一笔付款的情况下，该舞蹈演员受了重伤，好几个月无法工作。当她错过一次月度付款时，经纪人通知她，他打算收回公寓的占有权。舞蹈演员拒绝交出占有权，除非经纪人退还她多年来支付的部分款项。

以下哪项是法院最不可能裁定的结果？

zh-choices.A: 要求经纪人对该房产启动司法止赎程序。
zh-choices.B: 要求经纪人在舞蹈演员交出房产时，向其支付返还款。
zh-choices.C: 要求舞蹈演员就拖欠的款项向经纪人作出补偿，以保留占有权。
zh-choices.D: 要求舞蹈演员支付剩余的合同余款以保留占有权并获得所有权。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Types of security devices

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合同契据（contract for deed / installment land contract）违约后，法院通常不会让买方只靠补偿逾期款就继续占有房屋。

三秒认题路径：

合同契据 → 买方违约 → 卖方收回 → 看救济 → 选最不可能

核心法律规则

合同契据（contract for deed）又叫分期土地买卖合同（installment land contract），考场意思：买方先占有，卖方先保留产权，等最后一期款付清才过户。

买方违约后，传统做法是卖方直接没收已付款并收回房屋；但很多州会把它当成类似抵押（mortgage）的交易，要求司法止赎（foreclosure）、给买方衡平赎回权（equitable right of redemption），或者给买方部分返还（restitution）。

但买方不能只说“我把漏付的钱补上”，就当然继续占有；这不是本题里法院最可能强加的救济。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 3.4 — 把合同契据当作抵押替代工具时，法院更倾向止赎、赎回权或返还，而不是单纯补缴欠款保房。

思维导图

看到 合同契据（contract for deed），先问：违约后能不能只补钱继续住？
第一步：买方先占有，卖方保留产权，说明这是 分期土地买卖合同（installment land contract）。
传统规则：卖方可没收已付款并收回房屋。
现代救济：要么 司法止赎（foreclosure），要么给 衡平赎回权（equitable right of redemption），要么给部分 返还（restitution）。
卡死点：indemnify 只是补偿欠款，不等于赎回产权，也不等于当然保住占有。
所以本题问的是：哪种结果最不可能？答案落在“只补漏付款就继续占有”这条路上。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然买方愿意把欠款补上，法院就应该让她继续住下去。

但考试真正问的是：法院会不会把补缴逾期款（indemnifying the seller）当成恢复占有的正式救济；答案通常是否定的。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「物理上先把钱补了行不行」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干已写明是合同契据违约后的救济问题；法院会考虑止赎、赎回权或返还，但不会把单纯补偿欠款当成恢复占有的办法。

❌ 法律适用 | 终局救济误判

✕ A: 直接套foreclosure，但本题问的是最不可能的结果，不是唯一可能路径。

❌ 事实误判 | 返还范围偷换

✕ B: 把restitution当成当然规则，忽略它只是可选的衡平性补救。

❌ 概念混淆 | 赎回权错位

✕ D: 这是equitable right那一路，但题干没有说法院必须给她补足余款的赎回机会。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认出是合同契据，再把“补钱继续住”与“赎回或止赎”分开，最后找最不可能的救济。

考场速记

记住一句：合同契据（contract for deed）违约后，常见的是止赎（foreclosure）、赎回（redemption）、返还（restitution），不是“只补欠款就自动保房”。

看到“indemnify + 继续占有”，先警惕：这通常是命题人拿来骗你的。

reason.en: Identifies the security device and governs which default remedies apply.
reason.zh: 界定担保形式并决定适用何种违约救济。

keywords.text: monthly installments over a five-year period

reason.en: Shows buyer was near completion when default occurred, affecting modern buyer-protective remedies.
reason.zh: 表明买方在违约前已长期付款，影响现代买方保护性救济。

keywords.text: silent as to remedies in the event of any default

reason.en: Forces application of default state law remedies for contract-for-deed default.
reason.zh: 须适用州法对分期购地合同违约的默认救济规则。

reason.en: Triggers the seller's remedies and the court's choice among possible outcomes.
reason.zh: 触发卖方救济及法院在多种结果间的选择。

reason.en: States the seller's sought remedy and frames which judicial orders are plausible.
reason.zh: 表明卖方寻求的救济，框定法院可能作出的命令。

keywords.text: refunded some of the money that she paid him

reason.en: Signals the restitution remedy courts may impose instead of allowing total forfeiture.
reason.zh: 指向法院可能命令的返还救济，而非允许全部没收。

reason.en: Identifies the seller retaining title under the contract for deed.
reason.zh: 识别在分期合同中保留产权的卖方。

reason.en: Modern states often treat contract-for-deed default like mortgage foreclosure.
reason.zh: 现代州法常将此类违约按按揭止赎处理。

reason.en: Reflects the judicial process now commonly required before title is cleared.
reason.zh: 反映现今通常须先经司法程序方可清理产权。

reason.en: Matches the modern restitution remedy limiting harsh forfeiture.
reason.zh: 符合限制严苛没收的现代返还救济。

B.text: exceed the broker's actual damages upon forfeiture

reason.en: States the measure limiting how much the seller may keep after default.

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man decided to purchase an apartment building. To finance this purchase, the man borrowed funds from a bank. The man executed a negotiable promissory note and a mortgage to the bank in order to secure repayment of the loan.
Two years later, the bank sold its promissory note to a mortgage company by endorsing and promptly delivering the note to the mortgage company. Shortly thereafter, the man stopped making payments on the mortgage, and the mortgage company initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings against him. The man has moved to dismiss the suit.
Should the motion to dismiss be granted?

choices.A: No, because the mortgage was not assigned and is unenforceable by anyone except the bank.
choices.B: No, because the mortgage will be deemed to have been transferred with the promissory note.
choices.C: Yes, because the promissory note could not be assigned independent of the mortgage.
choices.D: Yes, because the promissory note required a separate document for assignment to the mortgage company.

questions.explanation:
Transfer of promissory note & mortgage
Transfer of note without mortgage The note can be transferred unless the transfer is expressly prohibited in the note/mortgage, forbidden by statute or public policy, or increases the mortgagor's duties, burdens, or risks.
Transfer of mortgage without note* Transfer is void. *Jurisdictions are split as to the effect of transfer.

To finance the purchase of real property, a borrower typically executes two documents that serve as evidence of the debt:

  • Promissory note – a formal "IOU" that sets forth the terms of the loan. It is the primary evidence of the debt and is not recorded in the deed records.
  • Mortgage (or deed of trust) – a lien that secures the loan by attaching the debt to a real property interest and providing a means of enforcement (e.g., foreclosure). It is recorded in the deed records to provide notice of an outstanding debt attached to the real property.

If a lender decides to sell its security interest, the lender can assign the promissory note independent of the mortgage to an assignee (Choice C). A nonnegotiable promissory note requires a separate assignment document to transfer ownership (Choice D). However, a negotiable promissory note can be transferred by merely endorsing and delivering the note to the assignee. Once the promissory note is properly transferred, the mortgage automatically transfers with the note (unless the parties agreed otherwise) (Choice A).

Here, the negotiable promissory note was properly transferred to the mortgage company upon its endorsement and delivery. The mortgage will be deemed to have automatically transferred to the mortgage company, so the mortgage company can enforce the mortgage through foreclosure. Therefore, the man's motion to dismiss this foreclosure proceeding should be denied.

📌 Educational Objective

A nonnegotiable promissory note must be transferred by a separate document, while a negotiable promissory note can be transferred by endorsing and delivering the note. Either note can be transferred independent of the mortgage, and the mortgage will automatically transfer with the note (unless otherwise agreed).

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (transfer of mortgages).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子决定购买一栋公寓楼。为了为此购买融资，该男子向一家银行借款。为了担保贷款的偿还，该男子向银行出具了一份可转让本票和一份抵押合同。

两年后，银行通过背书并及时交付该本票的方式，将其出售给了一家抵押公司。此后不久，该男子停止偿还抵押贷款，抵押公司对他提起了司法止赎程序。该男子已动议驳回此诉讼。

该驳回动议是否应被批准？

zh-choices.A: 不应批准，因为抵押合同未被转让，除了银行之外，任何人都不能强制执行。
zh-choices.B: 不应批准，因为抵押合同将被视为已随本票一并转让。
zh-choices.C: 应批准，因为本票不能独立于抵押合同进行转让。
zh-choices.D: 应批准，因为本票的转让需要一份单独的文件才能转让给抵押公司。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Transfer

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：可转让的借据（negotiable promissory note）一旦被背书并交付，抵押（mortgage）通常会跟着自动转移，债务人不能只靠“没单独转让抵押”来躲避止赎。

三秒认题路径：

可转让借据 → 背书交付 → 抵押随之转 → 银行已转出 → 不能驳回

核心法律规则

本票（promissory note）是债的主文书，抵押（mortgage）是担保这个债的附属权利。考场上先记：票随债走（the mortgage follows the note），所以只要借据被合法转让，抵押一般也一并过去。

如果是可转让票据（negotiable note），只要背书并交付（endorsement and delivery）就能转让；如果是不可转让票据（nonnegotiable note），才需要单独转让文件。这里银行已经把可转让借据背书并交付给公司，所以公司也取得了抵押权，可以继续止赎。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.4 — 票据合法转移后，抵押通常自动跟着转移。

思维导图

借款人 签本票 + 抵押
→
银行 持有债权与担保
→
贷方公司 背书 + 交付后受让
→
止赎 可以执行抵押
卡死点：题目不是在问“抵押有没有单独写转让书”，而是在问“票据转走后，抵押还在不在”。
先看：借据有没有合法转让？
是可转让票据已背书并交付 → 债权先转出去。
下一步抵押是否跟票走？
通常是，除非双方另有约定。
结论受让人可拿抵押去止赎 → 选 B。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：mortgage没单独签一份转让文件，所以公司不能起诉止赎。

但考试真正问的是：票据已经合法转让时，抵押会不会跟着走；答案是会，所以上诉式的“没单独转让”不是致命点。

司法考试看的是「法律关系有没有跟着转」，而不是「纸面上有没有再写一份抵押转让书」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干 背书并交付可转让本票 这一事实一出来，抵押就会随票据一并转移，所以贷方公司能继续止赎，不能驳回。

❌ 概念混淆 | 独立转让误判

✕ A: 把抵押当成必须单独存在的权利了，mortgage其实会跟着票走。

❌ 法律适用 | 反向搬规则

✕ C: 把“抵押不能脱离票据单独转让”偷换成“票据不能单独转让”，方向错了。

❌ 事实误判 | 误读形式要求

✕ D: 题干已经给了背书并交付，separate document是给不可转让票据的。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认出“票据转让”再看“抵押是否随附”，不要被“有没有单独转让抵押”带偏。

考场速记

记忆口诀：票随债走（the mortgage follows the note）。可转让本票看背书 + 交付（endorsement and delivery）；不可转让本票才看单独文件。遇到“票已转、抵押还在不在”的题，先想这句。

reason.en: Determines whether endorsement and delivery alone effect a valid transfer.
reason.zh: 决定仅凭背书并交付是否即可完成有效转让。

reason.en: Secures the loan and is enforced through foreclosure.
reason.zh: 担保贷款并通过止赎程序执行。

keywords.text: endorsing and promptly delivering the note

reason.en: Shows the note was properly transferred to the mortgage company.
reason.zh: 表明期票已合法转让给按揭公司。

reason.en: Tests whether the assignee may enforce the security interest.
reason.zh: 检验受让人是否有权执行担保权益。

reason.en: Frames whether the foreclosure plaintiff has standing to sue.
reason.zh: 界定止赎原告是否具备起诉资格。

reason.en: The party claiming enforcement rights after the note sale.
reason.zh: 期票出售后主张执行权的当事人。

reason.en: Implies the mortgage must be separately assigned to be enforceable.
reason.zh: 暗示抵押权必须单独转让才可执行。

A.text: unenforceable by anyone except the bank

reason.en: Misstates that only the original lender may foreclose.
reason.zh: 错误认为仅原贷款人可提起止赎。

B.text: deemed to have been transferred with the promissory note

reason.en: States the controlling rule that validates the foreclosure plaintiff.
reason.zh: 阐明支持止赎原告的支配性规则。

C.text: could not be assigned independent of the mortgage

label.zh: 期票与抵押不可分离转让

reason.en: Reverses the rule that a note may be assigned without a separate mortgage assignment.
reason.zh: 颠倒了期票可单独转让的规则。

reason.en: Applies the nonnegotiable-note rule to this negotiable instrument.
reason.zh: 将不可转让期票的规则误用于本案可转让期票。

highlights.text: negotiable promissory note

reason.en: Controls whether endorsement and delivery suffice for transfer.
reason.zh: 决定背书并交付是否足以完成转让。

highlights.text: endorsing and promptly delivering the note to the mortgage company

reason.en: Establishes that ownership of the debt passed to the foreclosure plaintiff.
reason.zh: 确立债务所有权已转移给止赎原告。

highlights.text: mortgage company initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings

reason.en: Raises whether the note purchaser may enforce the mortgage.
reason.zh: 提出期票购买人是否可执行抵押权的问题。

highlights.text: The man has moved to dismiss the suit.

reason.en: The outcome turns on whether the assignee holds enforceable mortgage rights.
reason.zh: 结果取决于受让人是否享有可执行的抵押权。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A landowner borrowed $100,000 from a lender and executed a valid mortgage on a commercial tract of land to secure the debt. The lender promptly recorded the mortgage.
A year later, the landowner conveyed the same tract to a developer by a deed that expressly stated that the conveyance was subject to the mortgage to the lender and that the grantee expressly assumed and agreed to pay the mortgage obligation as part of the consideration for the purchase. The mortgage was properly described in the deed, and the deed was properly executed by the landowner; however, because there was no provision or place in the deed for the developer to sign, he did not do so. The developer promptly recorded the deed.
The developer made the monthly mortgage payments of principal and interest for six payments but then stopped payments and defaulted on the mortgage obligation. The lender properly instituted foreclosure procedures in accordance with the governing law. After the foreclosure sale, there was a $10,000 deficiency due to the lender. Both the landowner and the developer had sufficient assets to pay the deficiency.
There is no applicable statute in the jurisdiction other than the statute relating to foreclosure proceedings.
At the appropriate stage of the foreclosure action, which party will the court decide is responsible for payment of the deficiency?

choices.A: The developer, because he accepted delivery of the deed from the landowner and in so doing accepted the terms and conditions of the deed.
choices.B: The developer, because he is estopped by his having made six monthly payments to the lender.
choices.C: The landowner, because he was the maker of the note and the mortgage, and at most the developer is liable only as a guarantor of the landowner's obligation.
choices.D: The landowner, because the developer was not a signatory to the deed.

questions.explanation:
Transfer of mortgaged property
Effect on buyer/transferee Effect on seller
Subject to mortgage Does not agree to pay loan & is not liable for debt Remains solely liable for debt
Assumption of mortgage Agrees to pay loan & is primarily liable for debt Becomes secondarily liable as surety

A mortgage is an interest in real property given to secure a debt. The debtor may freely transfer mortgaged property (unless otherwise agreed), but the mortgage will remain attached to that property even after it is transferred to another. The grantee's (eg, buyer's) obligations with respect to that mortgage depend on whether he/she either:

  • took subject to the mortgage – did not agree to pay and is not personally liable for the debt or
  • assumed the mortgage – expressly agreed to pay and becomes primarily liable for the debt, while the original debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.

Here, the landowner's deed to the developer stated that the developer expressly assumed and agreed to pay the mortgage. And though the developer did not sign the deed, he assumed the mortgage by accepting delivery of that deed (Choice D). Therefore, the developer is primarily liable for the lender's $10,000 deficiency. And since the developer has sufficient assets to pay the deficiency judgment, the landowner need not pay anything.

(Choice B) Because the developer assumed the mortgage once he accepted the landowner's transfer of the deed, he is liable for the deficiency judgment regardless of whether, or for how long, he had paid the mortgage.

(Choice C) Although the landowner was the maker of the note and mortgage, the landowner (not the developer) became secondarily liable as a guarantor (ie, surety) when the developer assumed primary liability for that mortgage.

📌 Educational Objective

A grantee assumes a mortgage when he/she expressly agrees to pay the debt. The grantee then becomes primarily liable for that debt, while the original debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Prop.: Mortgages § 5.1 (assumption of mortgage).
questions.zh-question:
一位土地所有者从贷款人处借款100,000美元，并在一块商业用地上设立了有效的抵押以担保该债务。贷款人及时登记了该抵押。

一年后，该土地所有者通过一份地契将同一地块转让给一位开发商。该地契明确规定，此次转让受限于对贷款人的抵押，并且受让人明确承担并同意支付该抵押债务，作为购买对价的一部分。该抵押在地契中有恰当的描述，且地契由土地所有者正式签署；然而，由于地契中没有为开发商提供签署的条款或位置，他没有签署。开发商及时登记了该地契。

开发商支付了六期月度抵押贷款的本金和利息，但随后停止支付并对抵押债务违约。贷款人根据适用法律，合法启动了止赎程序。止赎出售后，尚有10,000美元的差额未偿还给贷款人。土地所有者和开发商均有足够资产支付此差额。

在该司法管辖区内，除了与止赎程序相关的法规外，没有其他适用的法规。

在止赎诉讼的适当阶段，法院将判定哪一方对支付该差额负有责任？

zh-choices.A: 开发商，因为他接受了土地所有者交付的地契，从而接受了地契的条款和条件。
zh-choices.B: 开发商，因为他向贷款人支付了六个月的款项，构成禁止反言（estoppel）。
zh-choices.C: 土地所有者，因为他是票据和抵押的设立人，而开发商最多只作为土地所有者债务的保证人承担责任。
zh-choices.D: 土地所有者，因为开发商没有在地契上签字。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Transfer

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：受让人如果在契据里明确承担抵押（assume the mortgage），即使没签字，只要接收了契据，就会对抵押债务和不足额判决负责。

三秒认题路径：

写了承担 → 接收契据 → 视为同意 → 受让人主责 → 卖方变次责

核心法律规则

subject to mortgage 的意思是“房子带着抵押一起卖”，买方不自动替原债务人还债，考场意思：他只是接手了这块地，不背个人债务。assumption of mortgage 的意思是买方明确同意支付（expressly agree to pay），考场意思：他从“看房的人”变成“主要还债的人”。

一旦受让人承担抵押，原土地所有人通常退到次要责任（secondary liability），像担保人一样等着补位，不再是主还款人。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Prop.: Mortgages § 5.1 — 受让人接收已写明“assume”的契据时，即使不签字，也会承担抵押债务。

思维导图

借款人 / 原业主 先借钱并设抵押
→
契据写明 assume + agree to pay
→
开发商 接收契据即承担
→
违约 + 亏空 deficiency judgment
关键问法：开发商只是买了带抵押的地，还是已经“答应替债”？
如果只是 subject to：不个人还债，卖方仍是主债务人。
如果是 assumption：开发商主责，卖方变次责。
本题卡点：契据写了“expressly assumed and agreed to pay”，而且开发商接收了契据。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：他没签字，所以不能算承担抵押。

但考试真正问的是：他有没有通过接收契据把“承担付款”这件事接过去。

这里看的是契据里的法律效果，不是签名形式本身。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干已写明开发商 expressly assumed and agreed to pay，他接收契据后就成了主还债人，所以不足额判决由他承担。

❌ 事实误判 | 付款次数误判

✕ B: 把made six monthly当成关键，其实是否承担看契据，不看先付了几期。

❌ 法律适用 | 主次责任反转

✕ C: 误把原业主当主债务人；开发商承担后，原业主反而只是次要责任人。

❌ 概念混淆 | 签字要件偷换

✕ D: 以为not a signatory就没责任，但接受写明承担的契据就够了。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看契据有没有“承担抵押”，再看受让人有没有接受该契据，最后直接锁定不足额判决由谁扛。

考场速记

记住一句：subject to = 不替你还，assumption = 我来还；一旦写了 assume，原债务人就退到次要位置。

question_analysis.skill_tested: Identify primary liability after mortgage assumption

reason.en: Establishes the encumbrance that survives conveyance of the land.
reason.zh: 确立随土地转让仍存续的担保负担。

keywords.text: subject to the mortgage to the lender

label.zh: 承受既存抵押的转让表述

reason.en: Signals the deed addresses existing mortgage status, but must be read with the assumption clause.
reason.zh: 表明契据涉及既有抵押，但须与承担条款一并解读。

keywords.text: expressly assumed and agreed to pay the mortgage obligation

reason.en: Creates primary personal liability in the grantee when accepted.
reason.zh: 受让人接受转让后即对抵押债务承担主要个人责任。

keywords.text: no provision or place in the deed for the developer to sign

reason.en: Tests whether signature is required for assumption versus acceptance of the deed.
reason.zh: 考查承担抵押是否须受让人签字，抑或接受契据即可。

reason.en: Sets the procedural context in which deficiency liability is decided.
reason.zh: 界定法院判定不足额清偿责任所处的程序背景。

reason.en: The unpaid balance after sale determines which party owes the lender.
reason.zh: 拍卖后未清偿余额决定应向贷款人付款的一方。

reason.en: States the correct theory that acceptance binds the grantee to assumed terms.
reason.zh: 阐明正确规则：接受契据即受承担条款约束。

A.text: accepted the terms and conditions of the deed

reason.en: Links delivery and acceptance to enforceable assumption of the mortgage.
reason.zh: 将交付与接受联系为可执行的抵押承担。

reason.en: Misattributes liability to payment history rather than express assumption.
reason.zh: 误将责任归因于付款记录而非明示承担。

reason.en: Suggests liability arises from paying, but assumption already made the developer primarily liable.
reason.zh: 暗示因付款而生责，但承担已使其负主要责任。

C.text: maker of the note and the mortgage

reason.en: Invites the error that the original debtor remains primarily liable after assumption.
reason.zh: 诱使考生认为原债务人于承担后仍负主要责任。

reason.en: Misstates post-assumption roles by treating the developer as only a guarantor.
reason.zh: 误述承担后角色，将开发商仅当作保证人。

D.text: not a signatory to the deed

reason.en: Relies on missing signature to deny assumption, overlooking acceptance of delivery.
reason.zh: 以未签字否认承担，忽视接受交付即可成立承担。

highlights.text: expressly assumed and agreed to pay the mortgage obligation

reason.en: This language makes the grantee primarily liable once the deed is accepted.
reason.zh: 该表述使受让人在接受契据后对抵押债务负主要责任。

highlights.text: because there was no provision or place in the deed for the developer to sign, he did not do so

reason.en: The central trap fact; signature is not required when assumption is effected by accepting delivery.

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A baker borrowed funds from an investor to purchase a plot of land on which the baker planned to build a new bakery. In order to secure repayment of the loan, the baker signed a nonnegotiable promissory note and executed a mortgage to the investor.
Five years later, the investor sold her promissory note to a credit union by endorsing the note and promptly delivering it to the credit union. Due to a downturn in business, the baker was unable to make payments on the mortgage. The credit union now seeks to foreclose on the baker's plot of land.
If the court denies the credit union's foreclosure, what is the most likely reason?

choices.A: The mortgage required a separate written assignment in order for the transferee-credit union to enforce the mortgage.
choices.B: The nonnegotiable promissory note required a separate document for assignment to the credit union, so neither the note nor the mortgage transferred.
choices.C: The transfer of the nonnegotiable promissory note modified the terms of the loan, resulting in a release of the baker's personal liability.
choices.D: The transfer of the nonnegotiable promissory note without the mortgage was void.

questions.explanation:
Transfer of promissory note & mortgage
Transfer of both documents Both documents are transferred unless:
  • expressly prohibited in note/mortgage
  • forbidden by statute or public policy or
  • increases mortgagor's duties, burdens, risks
Transfer of note without mortgage
Transfer of mortgage without note* Transfer is void
*Jurisdictions are split as to effect of transfer.

To finance the purchase of real property, a borrower typically executes two documents that serve as evidence of the debt:

  • Promissory note – a formal "IOU" that sets forth the terms of the loan. It is the primary evidence of the debt and is not recorded in the deed records.
  • Mortgage (or deed of trust) – a lien that secures the loan by attaching the debt to a real property interest and providing a means of enforcement (e.g., foreclosure). It is recorded in the deed records to provide notice of an outstanding debt attached to the real property.

If a lender decides to sell its security interest, the lender can assign the promissory note independent of the mortgage to an assignee. A nonnegotiable promissory note requires a separate assignment document to transfer ownership. However, a negotiable promissory note can be transferred by merely endorsing and delivering the note to the assignee. Once the promissory note is properly transferred, the mortgage automatically transfers with the note (unless the parties agreed otherwise) (Choice A). The transfer of a promissory note without the mortgage is not void (Choice D).

Here, the baker signed a nonnegotiable promissory note. When the investor sold the note to the credit union, she endorsed and delivered the note but did not execute a separate assignment document. Because a nonnegotiable note cannot be transferred by endorsement and delivery alone, the note was not effectively transferred to the credit union. And since the mortgage follows the note, neither the note nor the mortgage transferred. The credit union therefore lacks the right to foreclose.

(Choice C) The transfer of the nonnegotiable promissory note did not modify the terms of the loan or result in a release of the baker's personal liability.

📌 Educational Objective

Although a negotiable promissory note can be transferred by endorsing and delivering the note to another, a nonnegotiable promissory note requires that a separate document of assignment be executed to transfer ownership.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (transfer of mortgages).

五年后，投资者通过背书（endorsing）该票据并将其及时交付给一家信用合作社（credit union），将该 promissory note 出售给了信用合作社。由于经营下滑，面包师无力支付 mortgage 还款。信用合作社现欲对面包师的土地提起止赎（foreclose）。
如果法院拒绝信用合作社的止赎请求，最可能的原因是什么？

zh-choices.A: 该 mortgage 需要单独的书面转让（separate written assignment），受让方信用合作社才能执行该 mortgage。
zh-choices.B: 由于该 promissory note 是不可流通票据（nonnegotiable promissory note），其转让给信用合作社需要单独文件，因此该票据和 mortgage 都没有转移。
zh-choices.C: 该 nonnegotiable promissory note 的转让修改了贷款条款，导致面包师的个人责任被解除。
zh-choices.D: 在未随附 mortgage 的情况下转让该 nonnegotiable promissory note 是无效的。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Mortgage transfers

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：非可转让本票（nonnegotiable promissory note） 不能只靠背书和交付转让；没有有效转让本票，抵押（mortgage） 也跟着过不去，所以受让人不能止赎。

三秒认题路径：

非可转让票据 → 需单独转让 → 只背书不够 → 本票未转 → 抵押不跟

核心法律规则

本票（promissory note）是债务本身的凭证；抵押（mortgage）是担保工具，平时是“跟着本票走”的。考场意思：先看本票有没有被有效转走，本票没转成功，抵押通常也不会单独活下来。

如果本票是可转让票据（negotiable note），可以靠背书加交付转让；如果是非可转让票据（nonnegotiable note），就需要单独的转让文书（assignment document）。考场意思：这题里只做了背书和交付，但票据本身不够“可转让”，所以转让没完成。

一旦本票没有有效转给信用合作社，抵押就不会有效跟随过去，信用合作社也就没有止赎资格。考场意思：不是“有房子抵押就一定能收房”，而是“先拿到债权，再谈担保物”。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.4 锁定本题：本票有效转让后，抵押通常自动跟随；但本题的非可转让本票没有被有效转让。

思维导图

借款人签 非可转让本票 债务凭证
→
投资人只做 背书+交付 本题关键动作
→
但还缺 单独转让文书 转让未完成
→
抵押 不会有效跟随 所以不能止赎

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然抵押是“跟着本票走”的，那把本票背书给信用合作社，抵押也应该自动过去。

但考试真正问的是：这张票据是不是非可转让票据（nonnegotiable note），如果是，就不能只靠背书和交付完成转让。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干明确是nonnegotiable promissory note，它需要单独转让文书；这里只有背书和交付，所以本票没转成，抵押也没跟过去，信用合作社当然不能止赎。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把“抵押跟本票走”误读成“必须单独写抵押转让书”。

❌ 法律适用 | 责任释放误判

✕ C: 误以为转让本票会改写贷款条款并放掉借款人责任。

❌ 事实误判 | 只看单句断章

✕ D: 以为“没带着抵押转”就会无效，其实无效的是本票转让方式。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认票据性质，再看转让方式；只要本票没有效转走，后面的抵押追随就不用想了。

考场速记

记忆口诀：票据先走，抵押后跟；如果是非可转让本票，先找单独转让文书，没有它就别急着说信用合作社能止赎。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man owned property that he used as his residence. The man received a loan, secured by a mortgage on the property, from a bank. Later, the man defaulted on the loan. The bank then brought an appropriate action to foreclose the mortgage, was the sole bidder at the judicial sale, and received title to the property as a result of the foreclosure sale.
Shortly after the foreclosure sale, the man received a substantial inheritance. He approached the bank to repurchase the property, but the bank had decided to build a branch office on the property and declined to sell.
If the man prevails in an appropriate action to recover title to the property, what will be the most likely reason?

choices.A: He had used the property as his residence.
choices.B: He timely exercised an equitable right of redemption.
choices.C: The court applied the doctrine of exoneration.
choices.D: The jurisdiction provides a statutory right of redemption.

questions.explanation:
Right of redemption
(regaining title after default on loan)
Timing Assertion of right
Equitable right
(always exists)		 At any time prior to foreclosure sale Pay full amount of debt due (including interest) to lender
Statutory right
(if statute exists)		 Statutory period after property has been sold in foreclosure Pay foreclosure sale price to purchasing party

When a debtor defaults on mortgage payments, the creditor may initiate foreclosure proceedings to force the sale of the mortgaged property to satisfy the unpaid debt. Once the property is sold, jurisdictions with a statutory right of redemption allow the original debtor to reacquire ownership of the property by paying the foreclosure sale price to the purchasing party — even if that party is the creditor — within a designated time. Therefore, the man will successfully redeem his property from the bank if the jurisdiction provides this statutory right.

(Choice A) Unless otherwise noted, the statutory right of redemption applies to any real property — not just residential property.

(Choice B) The equitable right of redemption allows a debtor to reclaim mortgaged property before foreclosure by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt. Therefore, the man did not timely exercise this right by attempting to repurchase the property after foreclosure.

(Choice C) The doctrine of exoneration allows a will beneficiary to use the estate's general assets to pay off any encumbrances (eg, mortgages) on the devised property. But since the man did not receive devised mortgaged property (he placed the mortgage on the property himself), this doctrine does not apply.

📌 Educational Objective

The statutory right of redemption allows a debtor to reacquire ownership of property after foreclosure by paying the foreclosure sale price to the purchasing party within the designated statutory period.

📚 References
  • 30 Am. Jur. 2d Executions and Enforcement of Judgments § 291 (2018) (statutory right of redemption).
questions.zh-question:
一名男子拥有一处用作其住所的房产。该男子从银行获得一笔贷款，并以该房产的抵押权作为担保。后来，该男子贷款违约。银行随后提起了适当的诉讼以对抵押物进行止赎，在司法拍卖中是唯一的竞标者，并通过这次止赎拍卖获得了该房产的所有权。

在止赎拍卖后不久，该男子获得了一大笔遗产。他联系银行希望回购该房产，但银行已决定在该地块上建造一个分行，因此拒绝出售。

如果该男子在收回房产所有权的适当诉讼中胜诉，最可能的原因是什么？

zh-choices.A: 他曾将该房产用作其住所。
zh-choices.B: 他及时行使了衡平法上的赎回权。
zh-choices.C: 法院适用了免除（遗产）负担原则 (doctrine of exoneration)。
zh-choices.D: 该司法管辖区规定了法定赎回权。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Pre-Foreclosure Rights And Duties

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：法定赎回权（statutory right of redemption）是否让抵押人能在止赎拍卖（foreclosure sale）后，按拍卖价把房子赎回来。

三秒认题路径：

默认贷款 → 已止赎 → 想回购 → 看法定期 → 选 D

核心法律规则

衡平赎回权（equitable right of redemption）只管before foreclosure sale，考场意思：拍卖前把本息一次付清，才能止住房子被卖。法定赎回权（statutory right of redemption）则是after foreclosure sale，考场意思：拍卖后在法定期间内，向买受人支付拍卖价（foreclosure sale price），就可能把产权拿回来。

题干里银行已经拍卖并拿到产权，所以衡平赎回权已经过期；他后来才来出钱，只能靠法定赎回权。只要该辖区有这个制度，他就有机会成功收回标题。

核心判例： 本题不靠特定判例名，而是直接锁定止赎后的statutory redemption规则：拍卖后想救房子，问的是法定期内有没有按拍卖价赎回。

思维导图

先问：他是在拍卖前，还是拍卖后想把房子拿回？
拍卖前 → 走 衡平赎回权（equitable right of redemption）
要点：必须在 foreclosure sale 之前，把全部债务连本带息付清给 lender。
拍卖后 → 先看州法有没有 法定赎回权（statutory right of redemption）
有 → 在法定期间内付 拍卖价（foreclosure sale price） 给买受人
本题银行已在拍卖后拒绝转卖，但如果州法给赎回权，仍可依法夺回产权。
没有 → 拍卖后就不能靠“我现在有钱了”翻盘
结论：题干最像的是拍卖后赎回，所以答案看州里有没有 statutory right。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：他用的是自住房，后来又拿到一大笔钱，银行又是唯一竞买人，所以应该能直接把房子买回来。

但考试真正问的是：拍卖后能不能靠法定赎回权（statutory right of redemption）把产权要回，不是看房子是不是住宅、也不是看银行愿不愿意再卖。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的关键是止赎拍卖后才来赎回，这只有在辖区提供法定赎回权（statutory right of redemption）时才行；他不是在拍卖前补足欠款，而是在拍卖后按拍卖价回收产权。

❌ 事实误判 | 住宅条件偷换

✕ A: 把residence当成胜负点了，赎回权并不只给住宅。

❌ 法律适用 | 时点错位误判

✕ B: 他是拍卖后才去谈回购，equitable 赎回早就过时了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 遗产清偿误判

✕ C: exoneration 是继承房产时用的，不是自己先抵押再止赎的这题。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓时间点：拍卖前看 equitable，拍卖后看 statutory，别被“我现在有钱了”带偏。

考场速记

记忆口诀：拍卖前找 equitable redemption，拍卖后找 statutory redemption；前者付全部债务，后者付拍卖价。以后看到“想把止赎后的房子赎回来”，先问州里有没有法定赎回期，再决定能不能赢。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman borrowed $100,000 from a bank and executed a promissory note to the bank in that amount. As security for repayment of the loan, the woman's brother gave the bank a mortgage on a tract of land solely owned by him. The brother did not sign the promissory note.
The woman subsequently defaulted on the loan, and after acceleration, the bank instituted foreclosure proceedings on the brother's land. The brother filed a timely objection to the foreclosure.
Will the bank succeed in foreclosing on the tract of land?

choices.A: No, because a mortgage from the brother is invalid without a mortgage debt owed by him.
choices.B: No, because the bank has an equitable mortgage rather than a legal mortgage.
choices.C: Yes, because the bank has a valid mortgage.
choices.D: Yes, because the bank is a surety for the brother's mortgage.

questions.explanation:
Mortgage documents
Mortgage deed A writing that conveys an interest in collateral to secure a debt
Promissory note A formal "IOU" in which the borrower promises to repay the debt according to the listed terms

A mortgage is a lien against real property given to secure repayment of a debt. If the debt (evidenced by a promissory note) belongs to someone other than the mortgagor, then the mortgagor is not personally liable for repaying that debt.† However, the mortgagee can foreclose on the mortgaged property if the debtor defaults.

Here, the woman received a $100,000 loan from the bank, which was evidenced by a promissory note. The brother did not sign the promissory note, so he is not personally liable for the debt. But since he used his tract of land to secure repayment of the woman's debt, the bank has a valid mortgage on that land. Therefore, the bank will succeed in foreclosing on the brother's land after the woman defaulted on the loan.

†The mortgagor would be personally liable for the debt if the mortgage itself contained language to that effect.

(Choice A) The fact that the mortgage debt is owed by someone else does not render the mortgage from the brother invalid. It merely means that the brother is not personally liable for repaying the mortgage debt.

(Choice B) An equitable mortgage is a mortgage alternative that arises when a party takes possession of the original deed to property with the intent that the property serve as security for a debt (not seen here).

(Choice D) A surety is a party who guarantees to pay another's debt in the event that person fails to do so. Here, the bank has not agreed to pay the debt for the woman if she defaults, so the bank is not a surety.

📌 Educational Objective

A mortgage can be given to secure repayment of a debt owed by someone other than the mortgagor, and the mortgagee can foreclose on the mortgaged property if the debtor defaults.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 1.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (mortgages securing obligations of nonmortgagors).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Foreclosure

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：抵押（mortgage）可以担保借款人以外的人的债务，所以哥哥没签票据也不妨碍银行对他的土地止赎（foreclosure）。

三秒认题路径：

他人债务 → 土地担保 → 不看个人欠款 → 债务违约 → 可以止赎

核心法律规则

抵押（mortgage）本质上是给不动产设一个担保，用来保证债务能还上。抵押人（mortgagor）不是票据上的借款人，也不代表抵押无效；结果只是他通常不承担个人还款责任。只要被担保的债务违约，抵押权人（mortgagee）仍然可以对这块地止赎（foreclose）。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 1.3 —— 明确说了：抵押可以担保非抵押人的债务，违约后仍可对抵押物执行止赎。

思维导图

银行 贷款人 / 抵押权人
→
女方 签票据，欠债的人
→
哥哥的土地 拿来作担保的抵押物
关键点：债务人是女方，不是哥哥。
法律后果：哥哥不用亲自还钱，但土地照样能被拿去执行。
卡死结论：债务属于别人 ≠ 抵押无效。
答案走向：银行可以对哥哥的土地止赎。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：没签票据的人不欠钱，那抵押一定不成立。

但考试真正问的是：土地有没有被有效拿来担保这笔债，而不是哥哥本人要不要当还款人。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干已给出哥哥把土地拿来担保女方贷款这一关键事实，所以银行有有效抵押，女方违约后当然可以对该地止赎。

❌ 概念混淆 | 责任主体误判

✕ A: 把mortgage debt当成必须由哥哥本人欠的债。

❌ 事实误判 | 押物类型偷换

✕ B: 硬把题目说成equitable mortgage，但这里是正式抵押，不是代位替代。

❌ 法律适用 | 保证人角色乱套

✕ D: 误把银行说成surety，其实银行是放贷方，不是替别人担保的人。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“谁欠钱、谁拿地担保”，再区分个人责任和对抵押物的执行。

考场速记

记住这句：债务人可以和抵押人不是同一个人；只要担保有效，违约后还是能对抵押物止赎。口诀可记成：In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely 这类中间上诉口诀不属于本题，但本题的对应速记是“债不归我，地仍能押”。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A woman borrowed money from her local credit union to purchase an undeveloped lot on which to build her dream home. She executed a promissory note agreeing to repay the loan over a 10-year period. The loan was secured by a deed of trust that contained a power-of-sale clause. The deed of trust was promptly recorded.
After the woman missed five loan payments, the credit union accelerated the debt and instructed the trustee to initiate nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings as permitted by the jurisdiction. The trustee followed the jurisdiction's notice requirements and procedures. At the foreclosure sale, the credit union was the sole bidder. The winning bid was equal to the remaining obligation on the note, amounting to only 60% of the fair market value of the property.
The woman immediately filed an action against the credit union to set aside the foreclosure sale.
Is the woman likely to prevail?

choices.A: No, because a court cannot overturn a nonjudicial foreclosure on a deed of trust.
choices.B: No, because there is no indication that the procedure or price would shock the conscience of the court.
choices.C: Yes, because a deed of trust can be foreclosed upon only by judicial foreclosure.
choices.D: Yes, because a lender may not purchase the mortgaged property at a nonjudicial foreclosure.

questions.explanation:
Foreclosure methods
Judicial sale (all states) Judicially supervised public sale of mortgaged property.
Nonjudicial sale (half of all states) Privately conducted public sale of mortgaged property (permitted only if mortgage contains power-of-sale clause).
Strict foreclosure (few states) Foreclosure without sale of mortgaged property.

A debtor may give his/her interest in real property to a lender to secure a debt—usually through a mortgage or a deed of trust. A deed of trust is created when the debtor conveys the property interest to an impartial third party, as trustee, who holds title to the property for the lender's benefit. If the debtor pays the debt in full, then the trustee must reconvey the property to the debtor. But if the debtor defaults on loan payments, the trustee can initiate foreclosure proceedings (see table above).

The trustee can initiate nonjudicial foreclosure in about half of all states if the mortgage or deed of trust contains a power-of-sale clause—as seen here (Choice C). This allows the trustee to sell the property at a public auction without requesting permission from the court. However, the debtor can ask a court to overturn the foreclosure if the auction or sales process violated due process or the purchase price was grossly inadequate* (Choice A).

Here, there was no due process violation because the jurisdiction's notice requirements and procedures were followed. And though the credit union's winning bid was only 60% of the property's fair market value, it was equal to the remaining obligation on the note. Therefore, this credit bid was not grossly inadequate. Because neither the procedure nor the price would shock the conscience of the court, the woman is not likely to prevail in her action to set aside the foreclosure sale.

*Courts have consistently been unwilling to impose a "fair market value" standard on the purchase price, so the lender can credit bid up to the amount of the outstanding debt without paying additional cash. Purchase prices have been deemed grossly inadequate if they are below 20% of the fair market value.

(Choice D) A mortgagee-lender who conducts a nonjudicial foreclosure sale cannot purchase the property at the sale. But a beneficiary-lender of a deed of trust (as seen here) can purchase the property at a similar sale held by the trustee.

📌 Educational Objective

Nonjudicial foreclosures are allowed in most states if the mortgage or deed of trust contains a power-of-sale clause. However, the court can overturn the foreclosure if the auction or sales process violated due process or the purchase price was grossly inadequate.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages §8.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (adequacy of foreclosure sale price).

一名女性从当地信用合作社贷款，用于购买一块未开发的土地，以建造她梦想中的家园。她签署了一份本票，同意在10年内偿还贷款。该贷款由一份包含售卖权条款的信托契约（deed of trust）作为担保。该信托契约被及时登记。

在该女性拖欠五期贷款后，信用合作社宣布债务加速到期，并指示受托人根据该司法管辖区的许可，启动非法定止赎程序。受托人遵守了该司法管辖区的通知要求和程序。在止赎拍卖中，信用合作社是唯一的出价人。中标价格与本票上剩余的债务金额相等，仅为该房产公平市场价值的60%。

该女性立即对信用合作社提起诉讼，要求撤销此次止赎拍卖。

该女性是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为法院不能推翻基于信托契约的非法定止赎。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为没有迹象表明程序或价格会冲击法院的良知。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为信托契约只能通过法定止赎来执行。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为在非法定止赎中，贷款人不得购买抵押房产。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Foreclosure

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：非司法止赎（nonjudicial foreclosure）后，债务人能不能靠“程序合规但价格偏低”把拍卖撤掉。

三秒认题路径：

信托契据 → 约定售卖权 → 非司法拍卖 → 看程序/价格 → 不能轻易撤销

核心法律规则

这题只用这条规则

有 附带售卖权（power-of-sale clause） 的 信托契据（deed of trust），通常可以做 非司法止赎（nonjudicial foreclosure）。考场意思：不用先去法院申请许可，受托人就能卖。

债务人要想撤销拍卖，必须抓住两个点之一：程序正当程序（due process）被破坏，或者价格低到会“shock the conscience”。考场意思：不是看你心里觉得亏，而是看法院会不会认为低到离谱。

核心判例：Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 8.3 这类规则告诉你：止赎价一般不是按“公平市价”卡死，而是看是否低到明显不合理。

思维导图

先看：这是不是“能立刻撤销拍卖”的题？
第1步有 deed of trust + power-of-sale → 允许 非司法止赎。
第2步受托人按州通知和程序做了 → 程序攻击点被堵死。
第3步看价格：买受人是贷款人，credit bid 等于剩余债务 → 不是当然无效。
第4步只有“极低到离谱”的价格才会动摇结果；60% FMV 不够触发。
结论程序没错、价格没低到震撼法院 → 选“不胜诉”。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：60% FMV 好像太便宜了，应该能直接撤销。

但考试真正问的是：州法程序已经走完后，这个价格有没有低到让法院觉得“太离谱”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

另外，别被“贷款人自己出价”吓到：在 deed of trust 的受托人止赎里，受益贷款人可以像这里一样用 credit bid 竞标。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干 程序已合规，而 60% 的出价又等于未清债务，不到“震撼法院”的程度，所以她撤销失败。

❌ 概念混淆 | 绝对禁止误判

✕ A: 把 nonjudicial 误当成“完全不能审查”。

❌ 法律适用 | 止赎方式错位

✕ C: 把 deed of trust 说成只能走司法止赎。

❌ 事实误判 | 受益人出价偷换

✕ D: 以为 lender 绝不能参加这种拍卖。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓止赎类型，再只检验“程序是否合规 + 价格是否低到离谱”。

考场速记

记住一句：有售卖权，就先想非司法止赎；想撤销，就盯程序和价格。

价格题不要死盯“市价”，要盯它有没有低到法院会说 shock the conscience。

questions.subject: Real Property
questions.question:
A man who owned property in fee simple mortgaged the property to a bank to secure a loan of $100,000. The mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The man later mortgaged the property to his mother to secure a loan of $50,000. This mortgage was also promptly and properly recorded. Subsequently, the man conveyed the property to a purchaser. About a year later, the purchaser borrowed $100,000 from an elderly widow and gave her a mortgage on the property to secure repayment of the loan. The widow did not know about the mortgage held by the mother. The understanding between the purchaser and the widow was that the purchaser would use the $100,000 to pay off the mortgage held by the bank and that the widow would therefore have a first mortgage on the property. The widow's mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The purchaser paid the $100,000 received from the widow to the bank and obtained and recorded a release of the bank's mortgage.
The $50,000 debt secured by the mother's mortgage was not paid when it was due, and the mother brought an appropriate action to foreclose, joining the man, the purchaser, and the widow as defendants and alleging that the mother's mortgage was senior to the widow's mortgage on the property.
If the court rules that the widow's mortgage is entitled to priority over the mother's mortgage, which of the following determinations are necessary to support that ruling?

choices.A: The bank's mortgage was originally senior to the mother's mortgage.
choices.B: The widow is entitled to have the bank's mortgage revived for her benefit, and the widow is entitled to be subrogated to the bank's original position as senior mortgagee.
choices.C: There are no countervailing equities in favor of the mother.
choices.D: All of the above.

questions.explanation:
Subrogation

No actual knowledge of junior mortgage
Senior mortgage
Junior mortgage
Subrogating mortgage
First in time

Lien priority抵押权优先顺位：多个担保权益对同一不动产主张清偿顺序时的先后次序。 is generally determined by who records first (ie, first in time, first in right). However, subrogation allows a third party who fully pays off a senior mortgage to take that senior mortgage's priority so long as the third party had no actual knowledge of junior interests.* This does not harm junior interests because they retain the same lien priority.

Here, the bank's mortgage was recorded first, so it had priority over the mother's mortgage. The widow's mortgage was recorded last. However, the widow's loan was used to fully pay off the bank's senior mortgage, and the widow did not know about the mother's mortgage. As a result, the widow acquired the bank's senior mortgage through subrogation. Also, there are no equities in the mother's favor because she has retained her second-in-priority status (Choices A, B & C).

*In a minority of jurisdictions, record notice登记通知：通过查阅公共土地记录即可推定知晓已登记的权益。 is also sufficient to preclude subrogation.

📌 Educational Objective

Subrogation allows a third party to take a senior mortgage's priority when the third party (1) fully pays off the senior mortgage and (2) has no actual knowledge of junior interests.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.6 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (doctrine of subrogation).
questions.zh-question:
一名拥有房产完全所有权（fee simple）的男子将该房产抵押给一家银行，以担保一笔10万美元的贷款。该抵押权被及时并适当地进行了登记。随后，该男子又将该房产抵押给他的母亲，以担保一笔5万美元的贷款。这笔抵押权也同样被及时并适当地进行了登记。之后，该男子将房产转让给了一名买方。大约一年后，该买方向一位年迈的寡妇借款10万美元，并将该房产抵押给她以担保贷款的偿还。该寡妇并不知道其母亲持有的抵押权。买方与寡妇之间的约定是，买方将用这10万美元来清偿银行持有的抵押贷款，因此寡妇将获得该房产的第一顺位抵押权。寡妇的抵押权被及时并适当地进行了登记。买方将从寡妇处收到的10万美元支付给了银行，并获得及登记了银行抵押权的解除文件。

由母亲的抵押权所担保的5万美元债务到期未付，于是母亲提起了适当的止赎诉讼，并将该男子、买方和寡妇列为被告，声称母亲的抵押权优先于寡妇对该房产的抵押权。

如果法院裁定寡妇的抵押权有权优先于母亲的抵押权，那么以下哪项裁定是支持该判决所必需的？

zh-choices.A: 银行的抵押权最初优先于母亲的抵押权。
zh-choices.B: 寡妇有权为其利益而使银行的抵押权复活，并且寡妇有权代位取得(subrogated to)银行作为优先顺位抵押权人的原始地位。
zh-choices.C: 不存在对母亲有利的、足以抗衡的衡平法权益(countervailing equities)。
zh-choices.D: 以上所有选项。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages/Security Devices - Foreclosure

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：后来出资人替先前优先抵押权人还清贷款后，能不能通过代位（subrogation）拿到原来的优先顺位，压过 junior mortgage。

三秒认题路径：

先看先后顺位 → 再看是否清偿 → 再看有无实际知情 → 结论：代位能否生效

核心法律规则

抵押权优先顺位（lien priority）通常按先登记先得，也就是first in time, first in right：先录入的抵押权先赢。代位（subrogation）的考场意思是：第三人如果完全清偿（fully pay off）先前的 senior mortgage，而且对 junior interest 没有实际知情（actual knowledge），就可以站到原来 senior mortgage 的位置。这样不会伤到 junior mortgage，因为它的相对顺位没有被“抹掉”，只是有人接手了前面的坑位。

核心判例： Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.6 — 这条规则锁定：无实际知情且全额清偿时，可代位到先位抵押权人的顺位。

思维导图

先看：谁原本在前？
事实1银行抵押先登记 → 先占 senior mortgage
事实2母亲抵押后登记 → 只是 junior mortgage
再看：后来出资人有没有踩中代位条件？
条件A widow 的钱全额清偿（fully pays off）银行
条件B widow 对母亲抵押没有实际知情（no actual knowledge）
卡死点：若能代位，widow 接手银行原位次，不是普通后手抵押权
最后结论
结果widow 可站到银行的 senior position → 压过母亲
答案必须同时支持 A、B、C，才能推出 D

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然 widow 的抵押是后来才录的，她当然排在后面。
但考试真正问的是：她是不是不是“普通后来人”，而是已经把银行的先位顺位接过来了。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「物理上后来有没有写进记录」。

这题最容易被“later recorded = always loses”骗走；真正要盯的是全额清偿 + 无实际知情这两个门槛。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干明确给出银行先登记、widow 用贷款全额付清银行，且她不知道母亲的抵押，因此代位成立并接手银行优先顺位。

❌ 事实误判 | 只看先后登记

✕ A: 只会背“先登记先赢”，却漏了 widow 已把银行债清掉。

❌ 法律适用 | 混成自动取代

✕ B: 把 revived 说成自动成立，题目还要证明无实际知情和先位原本存在。

❌ 概念混淆 | 误当衡平抗辩

✕ C: 只盯母亲有没有“公平”，却忘了先顺位本来就属于银行。

这题建议用什么方法？

先排顺位，再查代位门槛：原先位次、全额清偿、无实际知情，三步一起过才会改写优先权。

考场速记

记住一句话：先位抵押被全额还清后，出资人若对 junior interest 没有实际知情，就能代位（subrogation）拿到原来的 senior position。

口诀：pay off + no actual knowledge = step into senior shoes。

reason.en: Confirms the senior encumbrance was discharged, opening the door to subrogation.
